category.description: the single 311 service category for this request

department.description: the exact city unit that should handle the request

entities.description: neighborhoods, streets or intersections named in the text, copied exactly

prompts.v2_recovery:
You are labeling a Pittsburgh 311 street complaint. Return ONLY a flat JSON object with exactly these three keys: category, department, entities. Do NOT wrap in 'type', 'properties', 'required', or any schema keywords. Do NOT add explanation.

Example of the EXACT format required:
{"category": "Street Light", "department": "Allegheny City Electric", "entities": ["Forbes Ave", "Squirrel Hill"]}

Rules:
- category MUST be exactly one of: Road/Street Issues, Traffic and Street Sign Issues, Street Light, Pedestrian/Bicycle Concerns, Parking
- department MUST be one of: DPW - Street Maintenance, DOMI - Asphalt, DOMI - Traffic, DOMI - Permits, DOMI - Construction, DOMI - Streets, Pittsburgh Water and Sewer Authority, Allegheny City Electric, DPW - Park Maintenance, Police - AVU, Police - Zones 1-6, Parking Authority, Permits, Licenses and Inspections, 311
- Routing: pothole/snow/sinkhole/drainage/overgrowth -> DPW - Street Maintenance; repaving -> DOMI - Asphalt; sign repair or signal repair -> DOMI - Traffic; streetlight REPAIR -> Allegheny City Electric; new streetlight -> DOMI - Permits; generic 'Sign' complaint -> Permits, Licenses and Inspections; sidewalks/bike infra -> DOMI - Permits or Permits, Licenses and Inspections; illegal parking -> Police - Zones 1-6; abandoned vehicle -> Police - AVU; meters/permits -> Parking Authority
- entities: list neighborhoods and streets exactly as written in the text; empty list if none

Return the flat JSON object now, nothing else.
